task_definition.task_description: Please reserve 1 Apple AirPods for me, turn that reservation into a cart item, and then generate an invoice for me using the SAVE15 coupon, sent to alice@company.com with PayPal. After that, check the current UTC time, look up AAPL, get the USD to EUR exchange rate, estimate the trading cost for 170.25 as a standard stock trade, check the current NASDAQ market session, archive that market session snapshot for me, and then create a purchase-and-market summary document and send me an app alert about it.

user_input.query: Hi, I’m alice (user_id: alice), a standard user_tier customer with medium priority. On the app channel, please reserve quantity 1 of product_id p_apple_airpods for me, then convert that reservation into a cart item. After that, generate an invoice using coupon_code SAVE15, send it to alice@company.com, and use the paypal payment_gateway. Then check the current time in timezone UTC, look up stock_symbol AAPL, get the USD to target_currency EUR exchange rate, estimate the trading cost for 170.25 as a standard stock trade, and check the current market session for exchange NASDAQ. Please archive that session as “Session Market Snapshot,” then create a final document titled “Purchase and Market Session Summary” with the tags shopping, invoice, and market, and send me an app alert about it.
